### Absalom Takes Justice into His Own Hands
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/absalom-takes-justice-into-his-own-hands
Passage: 2 Samuel 13:28
Points:
- King David failed to impartially discipline Amnon for his crime, reacting only with passive anger.
- David's inaction prompted Absalom to bypass lawful authority and pursue private vengeance.
- Absalom calculated his revenge for two years, orchestrating Amnon's murder during a celebration.
- Bypassing proper justice brought lasting chaos and division to David's household and kingdom.
- Believers must pray for leaders in church and society to execute justice rightly and promptly.
